annotations.title: Ask a person to check something

description: Use when a real person must look at something before you act: an invoice, a document, a photo, a claim or a decision. A verified person answers and signs; the answer goes on a public record. $2 check, $5 expert review, $25 licensed sign-off. Example: {"question": "Do the line items add up to the invoice total?", "context": "Labor $450; Parts $212.50; Total $662.50", "answer_type": "yes_no"}. Docs: https://llpro.ai/human-check

agent_key.description: Your secret LLPRO agent key. With an Assisted or Done for you plan, the check is billed to the plan.

callback_url.description: Public https address; the signed answer is posted there when it's ready.

check_type.description: expert_review: one qualified domain expert reviews the item, sealed ($5). licensed_signoff: a vetted licensed contractor reviews and signs inside their licence ($25). To start: general (default, $2 a check, first 3 free), invoice_match, document_check, business_verify. human_task: a person does one phone or remote task up to 10 minutes and writes what happened ($10).

context.description: What the reviewer needs to see: the text, numbers or details to check.

options.description: The choices, when answer_type is choice.

question.description: One clear question a person can answer in a few minutes.

name: human_check_ask
